translations.answer: In the original Isaac Lab v2.1.1/Isaac Sim 4.5.0 environment, IMU reads the pose, velocity, and center of mass (CoM) buffer of PhysX rigid bodies via create_rigid_body_view, so the target prim must have RigidBodyAPI; only a transform with only transform will fail initialization. Subsequent merged PR #3864 added Xform mounting and automatic parent-body discovery, with testing. Actual handling should first check if the installation version includes this PR: if yes, use the new behavior; if not, must align the target to an available rigid body or re-evaluate the fix. Cannot assume any version has the old behavior.
translations.applicability: Original behavior corresponds to Isaac Lab v2.1.1/Isaac Sim 4.5.0; new behavior corresponds to code version containing PR #3864 (2025-12-10).
translations.credibility.rationale: The issue has been closed, environment is clear and there is no conflict, and precise references or independent reproducibility are provided.
translations.details.attempts.0: The questioner modified the IMU to support Xform; subsequent official PR #3864 implements automatic parent-body discovery and adds testing.
translations.details.diagnostics.0: Check if the target prim has UsdPhysics.RigidBodyAPI; confirm data comes from PhysX rigid body buffer via calls to create_rigid_body_view, get_transforms, get_velocities, and get_coms in imu.py.
translations.details.effective_fixes.0: Use a version containing PR #3864 to make IMU point to Xform and automatically discover an available parent rigid body; old versions cannot assume any Xform can directly create a rigid body view.
translations.details.environments.0: Isaac Lab v2.1.1; Isaac Sim 4.5.0; ergoCub; target prim=/ergoCub/root_link/torso_1/waist_imu_0; original implementation commit 77a6498.
translations.details.limits.0: The current Issue page still shows it as open; verification must be done per the target installation version, not just by the main merge date.
translations.details.outcomes.0: PR #3864 merged into isaac-sim/IsaacLab main on 2025-12-10, with description matching #3088, and the test added to confirm the fix is valid.
translations.details.problem_statements.0: Why does Isaac Lab fail to initialize when the IMU's target prim is just a transform with valid transform, but no RigidBodyAPI?
translations.details.safety_notes.0: After changing the IMU reference prim or upgrading the implementation, verify the output reference frame, bias, and installation extrinsic, before using it in closed-loop WBC.
translations.details.suspected_causes.0: Old IMU implementation only read data from PhysX rigid body buffers, which were maintained by the physics engine; regular transforms do not have these data.
translations.details.symptoms.0: ImuCfg initialization throws RuntimeError: Failed to find a RigidBodyAPI for the prim paths.
translations.media_summaries.0: The original post includes a screenshot of the target prim interface, but the root cause and resolution can be independently verified via the error message, source code trace, and merged PR; no extra information can be inferred from the screenshot.
translations.source.locator: Issue #3088's environment, error, and author code analysis; merged PR #3864
translations.source.title: Old Isaac Lab IMU cannot directly mount to a regular Xform; subsequent merged automatic parent-body discovery
